name: Kurumi Haruka
source:
She is usually reserved, but Haruka is a pure and straightforward girl. Sometimes, she sees some strange film footage-like flashbacks (memories?) in her head. For some reason, she's often approached by those of the opposite sex. Due to this, she gets bullied by her female classmates. Her older brother, Masato, is always kind to Haruka and is her emotional support.

[Translation of her [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/index.html]official website profile[/URL].]
